author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Grok AI in this complete beginner's tutorial. I'll walk you through how to get started with Grok, generate AI images and videos, analyze documents, research topics, write content, review trends on X (Twitter), create apps and code, and connect Grok to apps like Zapier.  

Connect Grok to Zapier MCP to better automate your workflow for free: https://grok.kevinstratvert.com

Grok is a powerful AI assistant that can help you with everyday tasks, creative projects, research, and productivity. Whether you are brand new to Grok or looking to explore more of its features, this step-by-step tutorial will show you six practical ways to put Grok to work.

In this Grok AI tutorial, you'll learn how to:
   - Get started with Grok: Create an account, explore the interface, and understand how to use Grok for free.
   - Ask questions and research topics: Get helpful explanations, compare products, research information, and ask follow-up questions.
   - Generate AI images and videos:
title: How to Use Grok – Complete Beginner's Tutorial (2026)
